narratives.Problem: Setup Phase 2 teaches a bare plan.policy write that the same release's xBRIEF conformance gate rejects. Legacy-only policy input is migratable, but dual bare/namespaced blocks can remain shadowed and unsafe.
narratives.Change: Route every setup track through the public deft policy:* writer, make setPolicy fail closed on any dual policy block under the shared mutation lock, and prove the literal consumer command path produces conformant namespaced storage.
narratives.Scope: In scope: issue #3609; F1-F6 from the accepted adversarial critique; setPolicy shadow protection; setup pack source and generated skill; hermetic consumer-route and content contracts; operator docs; migration guidance; CHANGELOG. Out of scope: weakening conformance, a setup-only JSON writer, redesigning the policy registry, merging arbitrary dual blocks automatically, and hardening unrelated policy writers (F7 follow-up).
narratives.Impact: Changes shared policy mutation behavior for the two branch-policy commands and changes setup's persisted branch-policy default for all tracks from implicit fallback to explicit namespaced false unless trunk-based is confirmed.
narratives.Risks: A branch-value-only recovery could discard unrelated legacy keys; a check after the base write could destroy shadow evidence; handler-only tests could miss broken public argv; generated skill drift could reintroduce bare-key guidance.
narratives.Approach: Inspect re-entry state before any Phase 2 write; inventory entire dual blocks and halt for explicit reconciliation; repeat the shadow assertion inside setPolicy's lock; invoke fixed literal deft policy:* command vectors after every confirmed base write; halt on nonzero; verify read-back and conformance; update canonical pack source and regenerate the skill; add five-state regressions and literal anti-pattern checks.
narratives.Alternatives: Hand-writing the namespaced key was rejected because it bypasses locking, audit, and legacy migration. Relaxing conformance was rejected because the bare key is intentionally noncanonical. Auto-deleting equal branch values was rejected because equality must cover the entire policy block and may hide unrelated keys.
narratives.Dependencies: Existing policy CLI routes, setPolicy mutation lock and audit path, shadow diagnostics, migrate:category-b legacy-only migration, pack renderer, xBRIEF conformance evaluator, and issue #3609's accepted successor lean.
narratives.Confirmation: Flynn explicitly confirmed named change fix-3609-setup-policy with 'yes' on 2026-08-26.
